baseline_models.focus_anchor: The active form كَذَّبَ is directed through bi- at the substantivized حُسْنَىٰ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The clause stages more than uncertainty: an agent actively assigns falsehood to the good or beautiful as such.

activation_trace.role: Declaring a thing or its bearer false supplies the clause's active verdict.
Goodness or beauty opposed to ugliness supplies what the verdict repudiates.

changed_reading.before: He does not accept a favorable claim.
changed_reading.after: He actively classifies the good or beautiful itself as false.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: كَذَّبَ can concern whether a charge proves true in performance, while حُسْنَىٰ can name beneficent action.
baseline_models.mechanism: The denial can be enacted: the agent makes the charge of beneficent conduct fail by refusing to carry it through.

activation_trace.role: A charge that proves false by not being carried through turns denial into failed performance.
Beneficent, skillful action supplies the good whose practical realization is withheld.

changed_reading.after: His conduct makes the good's practical claim fail.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two focus roots permit an expectation-failure image to meet an ultimate-limit image.
baseline_models.mechanism: The clause can register anticipatory distrust: the best attainable end is treated like a provision expected to last but assumed to fail.

activation_trace.role: Milk that fails an expectation of continuance supplies a material image of disappointed reliance.
The utmost effort or limit lets حُسْنَىٰ function as the best attainable end.

changed_reading.before: He rejects a morally good object.
changed_reading.after: He treats the best attainable end as an expectation that will not hold.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening cover-and-disclosure cycle recasts denial as an overlay placed upon goodness that can become visible, not simply as absence of evidence.

activation_trace.role: The active assignment of falsehood anchors the reader's proposed re-covering.
Goodness and beauty provide the potentially perceptible object being covered.
Night's darkness supplies the scene in which visibility is withdrawn.
A covering that rises over and conceals something supplies the occlusive operation.
Day opening through light supplies the contrary condition of visibility.
Uncovering and appearance make disclosure an event rather than a static property.

structural_cues: 92:1 and 92:2 form an antithetical temporal pair: covering night and self-disclosing day.
The focus clause gives denial an active agent and a fixed object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies alternating cover and disclosure; I supply the arrow that denial can re-cover disclosed goodness. A live alternative is ordinary propositional rejection after disclosure.

changed_reading.before: Denial reports a settled negative judgment.
changed_reading.after: Denial can be an active occlusion of a good that has become available to sight.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured creation, paired differentiation, purposeful movement, and dispersed pursuits activate حُسْنَىٰ as an orienting limit; denying it leaves effort active but without a common measure.

activation_trace.role: Failure to carry a charge through lets denial appear as striving that does not fulfill its direction.
The utmost limit supplies a possible common endpoint for otherwise divergent striving.
Measuring and proportioning supply an ordered background for differentiated existence.
The masculine side supplies one pole of the explicitly paired differentiation.
The feminine side supplies the other pole without erasing distinction.
Purposeful movement toward an object makes striving directional.
Scattering supplies the loss of convergence among those directed movements.

structural_cues: 92:3's paired nouns are followed immediately by 92:4's declaration that strivings are diverse.
The focus's definite حُسْنَىٰ can function as a singular attractor amid plurality.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measure, paired difference, purposeful motion, and scattering; I infer that the focus ideal can orient the motions. The alternative is that diversity remains neutral and حُسْنَىٰ names only one moral option among it.

changed_reading.after: He rejects the orienting limit by which scattered effort could become coherent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The matched sequences make confirmation and denial materially testable: giving and self-protection enact confirmation of beneficent good, while withholding and claimed self-sufficiency enact its falsification.

activation_trace.role: A charge made false by failure to carry it through anchors denial as counter-performance.
Benefiting another and exceeding bare justice identify the practical content at stake.
Handing something over supplies the outward transfer that realizes the good.
Placing oneself within protection supplies the inward discipline paired with giving.
Realizing a promise or deed makes confirmation performative rather than merely verbal.
The repeated object identifies beneficent action as what the positive sequence verifies.
Stinginess supplies the withheld transfer that materially contradicts beneficence.
Claimed self-sufficiency supplies the posture that makes relation and gift seem unnecessary.

structural_cues: 92:5-6 and 92:8-9 are matched two-verse sequences ending in opposite verbs with the same prepositional object.
Giving contrasts with stinginess, and protective self-placement contrasts with asserted self-sufficiency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact parallel placement and opposed acts; I infer that those acts verify or falsify the ideal in practice. The alternative is that conduct merely evidences a prior doctrinal stance.

changed_reading.before: He holds a false belief about the good.
changed_reading.after: He falsifies the good in practice by withholding and treating himself as relationlessly sufficient.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated facilitation formula around opposed destinations turns the focus stance into path formation: denial becomes an entry condition through which obstruction grows easy to follow.

activation_trace.role: A charge that fails in execution anchors the stance as a trajectory, not an isolated statement.
The utmost limit supplies the destination from which the failing trajectory diverges.
Opening into ease supplies the positive path's increasing traversability.
Lightness and compliance in motion make even the negative path easy to enter and continue.
Twisting, opposition, and obstruction supply the paradoxical destination of that facilitated motion.

structural_cues: The same causative facilitation verb governs opposed destinations in 92:7 and 92:10.
92:10 follows the focus immediately, making denial a hinge between stance and route.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored facilitation and opposed ends; I supply the arrow of path dependence from stance to increasingly compliant motion. The alternative is an imposed consequence with no claim about habituation.

changed_reading.after: Denial is a hinge that makes a self-obstructing course progressively easier to travel.

context_deltas.mechanism: Claimed self-sufficiency precedes the focus, but wealth later fails to suffice at the fall; falsehood rebounds from the rejected best onto the material substitute trusted instead.

activation_trace.role: A provision that disappears instead of lasting supplies the focus's expectation-failure image.
The rejected good supplies the displaced object of reliance.
Self-sufficiency supplies the initial claim that no external good is needed.
Actual sufficiency is explicitly tested and found absent at the decisive moment.
Accumulated wealth identifies the concrete substitute expected to provide sufficiency.
Falling into destruction supplies the event at which the substitute's promise fails.

structural_cues: Forms of غ ن ي bracket the focus: asserted independence in 92:8 and failed sufficiency in 92:11.
The focus stands between the choice of substitute and the test that exposes it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies claimed sufficiency, wealth, and its failure at the fall; I infer a reversal in which the trusted substitute proves false. The alternative is a warning about greed without deliberate lexical rebound.

changed_reading.after: His declaration displaces trust onto wealth, which then becomes the provision that actually fails expectation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gentle indication toward a road, followed by possession of first and last, activates حُسْنَىٰ as a disclosed direction and terminal horizon rather than an unsupported promise.

activation_trace.role: Declaring something false anchors rejection of the offered direction.
The ultimate limit lets the good function as the road's horizon.
Gentle indication toward road and truth supplies disclosed direction rather than coercion.
A gift sent toward one held in affection lets guidance be received as offered relation.
Lateness after the first supplies the far end of the temporal span.
Beginning and precedence supply the near end from which the guided course opens.
Return to outcome makes the beginning root also carry the course's eventual issue.

structural_cues: 92:12 assigns guidance, and 92:13 immediately spans the latter and the first.
These declarations follow the two opposed facilitation destinations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a gently indicated road and a first-to-last span; I infer that حُسْنَىٰ can name its orienting end. The alternative keeps حُسْنَىٰ as ethical quality without a temporal or directional sense.

changed_reading.before: He rejects a claim for which he lacks direction.
changed_reading.after: He rejects a gifted direction whose beginning, route, and best horizon have been made available.

context_deltas.mechanism: Warning is meant to awaken protective caution, but the focus verb is later repeated beside bodily turning away; denial therefore becomes an orientation that converts available warning into exposure, opposite being moved aside and protected.

activation_trace.role: The focus verdict supplies the act whose directional consequences are unfolded.
The good supplies what the warned agent turns away from.
Warning that frightens in order to wake caution supplies a still-open protective function.
Kindled fire supplies the danger to which the warning points.
Pure blazing flame intensifies the warned exposure.
Meeting fire and its heat turns danger from a distant sign into contact.
Repetition of the focus verb carries its denial directly into the later characterization.
Turning the back and withdrawing gives the repeated denial a bodily direction.
Being distanced and kept apart supplies the contrary spatial outcome.
Repelling harm through protection completes the warning-to-safety alternative.

structural_cues: 92:14 warns, 92:15 names exposure, 92:16 repeats the focus verb beside turning away, and 92:17 reverses the spatial result.
The repeated كَذَّبَ joins the short focus clause to an embodied sequel.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies warning, contact, repeated denial plus turning, and protective distancing; I infer that denial blocks the warning-to-protection transition. The alternative is a classification of two agents without a claim about causal psychology.

changed_reading.before: He says that the good is false.
changed_reading.after: He turns away from the good in a way that disables warning and leaves him oriented toward exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence makes the good an economy of excess rather than equivalence: wealth is given for purifying growth, not to settle another person's favor, but toward a higher face and nurturing sovereignty, ending in acceptance and satisfaction.

activation_trace.role: Failure to carry a charge through anchors denial as refusal to enact this non-reciprocal good.
Benefiting another beyond bare justice supplies the focus ideal's gratuitous excess.
Giving supplies the outward movement by which the non-reciprocal good becomes actual.
Accumulated wealth supplies what is released rather than retained as self-sufficiency.
Growth and increase make relinquishment productive rather than merely subtractive.
A favor or good condition supplies the possible social debt that the clause negates.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the exchange model explicitly left behind.
Seeking supplies the positive aim that replaces repayment as motive.
Direction and orientation give that seeking a vector beyond the human exchange partner.
Nurturing, repair, and completion supply the relation within which released wealth becomes growth.
Elevation supplies the higher orientation that exceeds horizontal repayment.
Satisfaction opposed to resentment supplies the affective completion of the gift trajectory.

structural_cues: 92:18 couples outward giving with reflexive growth.
92:19 negates recompense, 92:20 supplies an exclusive higher aim, and 92:21 delays then promises satisfaction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies giving, growth, negated recompense, higher orientation, and satisfaction; the focus branch supplies beneficence beyond justice. I infer that حُسْنَىٰ can name a non-equivalent gift economy. The live alternative is a promised reward rather than the mode of giving itself.

changed_reading.before: He denies a future good or reward.
changed_reading.after: He rejects the beautiful excess by which giving escapes repayment, grows the giver, and reaches satisfaction through a higher orientation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines a dyed cloth whose appearance deceives with cosmic covering, disclosure, and a two-faced orientation. It remains anchored in both focus roots and branch-backed context, but downstream prose should present it only as a material metaphor for performed deception, not as a lexical translation of the clause.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The deceptive-surface branch of ك ذ ب directly meets the beauty branch of ح س ن inside the two-word focus clause.

activation_trace.role: A patterned cloth that lies through its condition supplies counterfeit appearance.
Beauty opposed to ugliness supplies the attractive surface being counterfeited.
Covering and concealment supply the overlay that lets appearance mask condition.
Disclosure supplies the event in which the counterfeiting surface can be exposed.
Two-facedness supplies the social analogue of a surface that presents incompatible orientations.

changed_reading.after: He may counterfeit beauty through a surface that conceals its contrary until disclosure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The zoomorphic motion image is branch-distant and therefore cannot replace the ordinary denial sense. It remains valid as an activation because the image belongs to the focus root and is reinforced by striving, facilitated motion, falling, and turning away; render it as an exploratory kinetic model only.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A focus branch images ك ذ ب as a wild animal that runs a stage, stops, and looks behind, while حُسْنَىٰ can supply the unrealized limit.

activation_trace.role: Running and then stopping to look back supplies an interrupted trajectory within the focus verb.
The utmost limit supplies the endpoint not reached by the interrupted motion.
Purposeful movement establishes the broader field in which interruption matters.
Compliant light motion supplies momentum after the focus hinge.
A fall into destruction supplies the kinetic course's eventual collapse.
Turning back and withdrawing confirms reversal rather than arrival.

changed_reading.before: Denial is motionless assent or dissent.
changed_reading.after: Denial can be pictured as striving that breaks, looks back, turns away, and converts momentum into a fall before the best limit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The packet's split mapping lets one source cue activate both gentle guidance and threat, but it does not establish that the source word lexically means both. The reading remains anchored because the contrast changes how focus-denial receives direction; downstream prose should mark it as a dual-register associative activation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus actively rejects an ultimate good, allowing the later guidance cue's dominant and non-dominant mapped branches to alter the felt register of that rejection.

activation_trace.role: Active falsification supplies the resistant reception of what is offered.
The ultimate limit supplies the direction's intended horizon.
The dominant mapped branch supplies gentle indication toward road and truth.
The non-dominant mapped branch supplies warning and threat as a harsher register.
Warning that awakens caution gives the harsher register contextual traction.

changed_reading.before: He rejects a neutral proposition about goodness.
changed_reading.after: He rejects a gently indicated horizon until the same directional address is encountered in the register of threat.

strongest_changes: The matched confirmation and denial sequences turn belief into material verification or falsification through giving versus withholding.
Mirrored facilitation turns the focus act into a hinge of path dependence, where even obstruction becomes easy to follow.
The wealth sequence reverses the accusation of falsehood: the rejected good is displaced by a substitute that itself fails expectation.
The closing gift sequence activates حُسْنَىٰ as beneficence beyond equivalence, oriented toward growth and satisfaction rather than repayment.
summary.what_was_special: The focus inventory lets ك ذ ب move simultaneously through verdict, failed performance, failed expectation, interrupted motion, and deceptive surface. The context materializes rather than collapses those possibilities through cover and disclosure, divergent striving, transfer and withholding, ease and obstruction, failed wealth, bodily turning, warning, and non-reciprocal gift.
remaining_uncertainties: حُسْنَىٰ may remain the good itself, the best promised outcome, an orienting limit, or the mode of beneficence beyond justice; the packet keeps all four live.
The facilitation sequence supports path dependence, but does not settle whether the operative arrow is habituated agency, imposed consequence, or both.
The non-dominant guidance-to-threat activation is associative evidence from a split mapping and should not be promoted to a lexical gloss.
